acceptance_criteria: A caregiver can change label and sentence of a concept on the board; the stored wording is what the child's board shows after closing
A reworded catalogue concept can be reset to the catalogue wording with one confirmed action
An entry a newer app wrote shows no reword or reset control and says that the app needs an update
Refusals (too long, empty, forbidden characters, profile too large) are explained in German and the typed text is kept
No other row moves when a wording is saved, and ids this version cannot edit keep their place
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: On a profile's board a caregiver changes the label and the spoken sentence of a concept and can go back to the catalogue wording; after closing, the child's board shows and speaks the new wording.
